content.what_it_is: Commented/teaching variant of the beach_2d plot_current.m MATLAB script with an explicit 'User Input' section (L4-L22): fdir set to '../input_files/output/' @L8 then immediately overridden by a Windows path 'C:\Users\Michael Lam\Desktop\simple_cases_input\beach_2D\' @L9 (unsuppressed, echoes to console); nfile=[1] @L12; time labels times={'200'} @L15; quiver stride sk=8 @L18. Adds a consistency check error() if length(nfile)~=length(times) (L24-L26). Then identical pipeline to plot_current.m: grid from eta_00001 (L29-L36, dx=dy=2.0), sponge outline (L39-L40), wavemaker outline (L43-L44), 4x5-inch figure (L47-L49); per file: load umean_/vmean_/Hsig_/mask_ (L60-L63), NaN-mask (L66-L68), pcolor Hsig with caxis([-0. 1]) (L70-L73), white quiver every sk-th point @L76, sponge/wavemaker outlines and rotated labels (L81-L88), axis labels on first panel (L90-L93), colorbar labelled '\eta (m)' (L95-L96); print command commented @L100.
entities: script; clear all @L2; variables: fdir @L8 (overridden @L9); nfile @L12; times @L15; sk @L18; eta @L29; n,m @L30; dx @L33; dy @L34; x @L35; y @L36; x_sponge @L39; y_sponge @L40; x_wavemaker @L43; y_wavemaker @L44; wid @L47; len @L48; num @L53; fnum @L57; u @L60; v @L61; ht @L62; mask @L63; h1 @L82; h2 @L86; cbar @L95
calls: error(...) @L25 on nfile/times length mismatch; builtins: load, size, sprintf, set/gcf/clf, pcolor/shading/caxis/colorbar, quiver, plot, text, xlabel/ylabel

verbatim_spans.text: error('Number of files to load does not equal number of time series values.')
% Plot resolution for vector field (sk=1 for full resolution)

unresolved: fdir is assigned twice (L8, L9): the shipped state points at a contributor's Windows Desktop path (Michael Lam) and the line lacks a semicolon; users must delete/edit L9 to run

times labels (L15) are validated (L24-L26) but never used in the plot (no title in this variant); colorbar label '\eta (m)' @L96 mislabels the plotted quantity (Hsig, loaded @L62); commented print name @L100 references the inlet_shoal case
Same quiver 2-D-subscripting of 1-D x/y as plot_current.m @L76; the Windows path @L9 points at simple_cases_input while data files are model output
